# PR #4311: Patch: follow-up to #4303 from the after-merge spot-check

Closes #4310

## What changed

I corrected one line of the player note for Black Hole in `crates/cards/patches/pending/stinkyscape-balance-changes-iv.json` (`player.balance`, line 28). Only the part in brackets changed:

- Before: "Black Hole closes after swallowing 7 permanents, down from 10 (its Radiant face never closes)."
- After: "Black Hole closes after swallowing 7 permanents, down from 10 (its Radiant face still closes after 10)."

Before editing, I checked the finding against three sources, and all three agree that the Radiant face still closes after 10:
- **Catalog:** `catalog.json` gives `stinkyscapeplus-077` the param `permanents` {base 7, radiant 10, tunedOn base}.
- **Script:** the header of `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c077_black_hole.rs` (lines 14–16) says the Radiant face "closes at the printed 10, which nothing moves".
- **Ruling:** `spec/rulings/R3561000.md` lists "a Radiant hole that never closes" under Rejected.

No other file changed. `git diff --stat` shows one file, 1 insertion and 1 deletion.

## How I tested it

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo jackioh patches check` | "every catalog change is claimed by exactly one pending fragment…", exit 0 |
| `cargo jackioh catalog check` | census printed, exit 0 |
| `cargo jackioh spec check` | "2310 rulings, 5812 proofs, 72214 citations in 4588 files, 31604 links: ok" |
| `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` | "classify: Internal", exit 0 |
| `cargo fmt --check` | exit 0 |
| `cargo test -p jackioh-tools r724001` | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` (whole crate; its `patches.rs` and `claims.rs` read the pending fragments) | every binary ok, main one 580 passed; the ignored tests are the crate's existing daily ones |
| `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/wording.test.ts` | 1 file, 15 tests passed. I ran it by name because it reads fragments from disk, so `--changed origin/main` may skip it |

I did not run clippy or the whole-workspace cargo and web suites. No Rust or TypeScript changed, and the harness runs them next.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **Kept and corrected the bracketed note instead of dropping it.** The issue allowed either. The Radiant card text doesn't mention closing, so a player reading "down from 10" could think the Radiant face changed too. The bracket says it didn't.
- **No new test.** A test that pinned this sentence would only repeat it. The shape and wording of every note are already checked by `patches check` and by `wording.test.ts`.
- **No new ruling and no `spec/pending/` paragraph.** R3561000 already settles this.

## Worth a second look

- **Possible race with #4303's promotion.** The plan notes that #4303's promotion pull request (branch `patches/ship-d95e050700`) copies the old false line into `patches.json`. The fragment was still in `pending/` when this run started, so I edited it there. If this merges first, `patches-ship.yml` should run again and ship the corrected line. If the old promotion merges first anyway, a follow-up must fix the same sentence in `patches.json`.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `claude-4`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 10 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 11.8 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 6s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 2s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 3s |
| clippy (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`) | pass | 134s |
| cargo tests (`cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"`) | pass | 1557s |
| web tests (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main --exclude '**/src/audio/**' --exclude '**/src/fx/**' --exclude '**/src/cards/art/convention.test.ts'`) | pass | 30s |

</details>
